defects.title: Key regex accepts lowercase free text (e.g. 'ali') — only format validation, not content
defects.invariant: Input validation — regex must reject semantically invalid values, not just structural mismatches; 'ali' is not a valid key format
defects.mechanism: low-B.md:177 references V1-RMD-541 — key regex pattern permits any lowercase string (e.g. 'ali') because it only checks format (likely ^[a-z]+$ or similar) without validating against actual key namespace/format rules (prefix, length, character set)
defects.acceptance: Tighten regex to enforce actual key format: required prefix, exact length, allowed character set (e.g. alphanumeric, specific prefixes like 'key_', 'idemp_'); add test cases for 'ali', 'test', 'foo' — all must be rejected

limitations: Only finding document (low-B.md) available; actual regex pattern source code not inspected. Defect inferred from finding description. Runtime validation behavior not tested.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
